content.application_contract: Requires one independently declared camera assembly with an attached lens barrel and actual bayonet lens mount. Preserve camera, lens and mount ownership and the actual attached state. A detached lens, bellows alone, lens hood attachment or screw-threaded mount does not substitute. Do not infer a brand, exact tab count, hidden lock state, autofocus, optical quality, sensor type or a lens-changing event.
content.definition: One declared camera assembly has a separate lens barrel attached at its own bayonet lens mount. The rear barrel boundary meets the receiving mount boundary on that same camera body, and the actual bayonet connection retains the barrel as part of that assembly. Barrel, mount and body keep distinct local boundaries without becoming loose adjacent props. The visible attachment does not select an assembly action or expose concealed internal fittings.
content.en: One declared camera assembly has a separate lens barrel attached at its own bayonet lens mount. The rear barrel boundary meets the receiving mount boundary on that same camera body, and the actual bayonet connection retains the barrel as part of that assembly. Barrel, mount and body keep distinct local boundaries without becoming loose adjacent props. The visible attachment does not select an assembly action or expose concealed internal fittings.
content.ko: 선언된 카메라 조립체 하나에는 자체 바요넷 렌즈 마운트에 붙은 별도의 렌즈 배럴이 있다. 배럴 뒤쪽 경계는 같은 카메라 본체의 받는 마운트 경계와 만나며 실제 바요넷 연결이 배럴을 그 조립체의 일부로 유지한다. 배럴, 마운트와 본체는 구별되는 국소 경계를 유지하며 옆에 따로 놓인 소품이 되지 않는다. 보이는 부착 관계는 조립 동작이나 숨은 내부 부품을 선택하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared existing object with an identified front, an adjacent actual side and their shared corner, plus open capture-camera pitch/yaw. Preserve all geometry, object orientation, count, camera height/distance, roll and requester locks. Do not create a side, corner, cabinet, product identity, architecture, support, room or new participant. Gaze, body turn, depicted camera hardware, a caption, camera-height label or front light does not supply the relation. Image geometry is not evidence of exact physical camera calibration.
content.definition: The taking camera has level pitch and oblique yaw relative to the same existing object’s actual adjacent front and side faces.
content.en: The capture camera has a horizontal optical axis directed obliquely toward the shared corner of the selected existing object’s front and adjacent side faces. Both actual faces remain visible and recede in different image directions, making their depth relation legible. The object keeps its existing shape and orientation. Camera height, distance and frame roll remain independently chosen; no product, box or building identity is required.
content.ko: 촬영 카메라는 선택한 기존 물체의 앞면과 인접한 옆면이 공유하는 모서리를 향해 비스듬한 수평 광축을 둔다. 두 실제 면이 함께 보이며 화면에서 서로 다른 방향으로 멀어져 깊이 관계를 읽을 수 있다. 물체는 기존 형태와 방향을 유지한다. 카메라 높이와 거리, 프레임의 롤은 독립된 선택으로 남고 제품·상자·건물 정체성을 요구하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently established existing iris, its base color, inner annular outline and darker outer margin. Preserve actual carrier and physical-versus-depicted domain. Do not invent a colored central ring, raised collarette, radial streaks, crypts, pupil geometry, extra eye, gaze, cosmetics, diagnosis or identity. All other properties retain their independent locks.
content.definition: Preserve an independently declared inner annular iris outline and darker outer margin on the same existing iris, without selecting a different inner or outer color.
content.en: The already declared iris retains its visible inner annular outline and its darker outer iris margin together in the same existing eye. The inner outline stays inside the iris, while the peripheral margin follows the boundary against the surrounding eye white. The independently established iris base color remains visible between these local structures.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 홍채가 같은 기존 눈 안에서 보이는 안쪽 고리 윤곽과 더 어두운 바깥 홍채 경계를 함께 유지한다. 안쪽 윤곽은 홍채 내부에 남고 주변부 경계는 인접한 흰자위와의 경계를 따른다. 독립적으로 설정된 홍채 바탕색은 이 국소 구조 사이에 보이게 유지된다.

content.application_contract: Requires one independently declared folding chair, seat, paired supporting legs and actual visible hinge connections. Preserve the actual chair construction, member count and hinge topology. Do not impose crossing legs, a central pivot, exact hinge count, material, a backrest design, hidden fasteners, load performance, an opening action or a seated person.
content.definition: The declared folding chair has a bounded seat and separate paired supporting leg members. Its visible hinges join the selected seat/support members as connected parts of that same chair. Each actual hinge and member retains its independently declared place in the chair assembly; the seat, legs and connection boundaries remain distinguishable. A human leg configuration does not supply a missing chair member.
content.en: The declared folding chair has a bounded seat and separate paired supporting leg members. Its visible hinges join the selected seat/support members as connected parts of that same chair. Each actual hinge and member retains its independently declared place in the chair assembly; the seat, legs and connection boundaries remain distinguishable. A human leg configuration does not supply a missing chair member.
content.ko: 선언된 접이식 의자에는 경계가 있는 좌면과 분리된 한 쌍의 지지 다리 부재가 있다. 보이는 경첩은 선택된 좌면과 지지 부재를 같은 의자에 속한 부품으로 연결한다. 각 실제 경첩과 부재는 독립적으로 선언된 의자 조립체 안의 위치를 유지하며 좌면, 다리와 연결 경계는 구분된다. 사람의 다리 자세는 빠진 의자 부재를 대신하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to the independently declared biological owner and already declared parts named here, whose requested shapes fit. Preserve exact species, count, color, established pose and scene. Quoted text, costume ornaments, figurative labels and neighboring bodies do not declare this owner. Develop only these same-owner structure properties; do not introduce an animal, transfer parts, infer transformation, health, mood or legal ownership. This research proposal remains discovery-only pending native semantic and owner admission review; all conditions, actual effects and requester locks require independent checking. The exact requested ear/tail shapes must already fit this fox; do not resolve a generic fox to red fox or add an unrequested muzzle or fur color.
content.definition: On the independently declared fox, the selected pointed ears have their bases in that fox's own head. Its bushy tail continues from the rear of the same body. The ear bases and tail base remain readable as parts of one living animal, with the existing tail outline retained around its attached base.
content.en: On the independently declared fox, the selected pointed ears have their bases in that fox's own head. Its bushy tail continues from the rear of the same body. The ear bases and tail base remain readable as parts of one living animal, with the existing tail outline retained around its attached base.
content.ko: 독립적으로 선언된 여우의 선택된 뾰족한 귀는 그 여우 자신의 머리에 밑동을 둔다. 풍성한 꼬리는 같은 몸의 뒤에서 이어진다. 귀 밑동과 꼬리 밑동은 하나의 살아 있는 동물의 부위로 읽히며 연결된 밑동 주위의 기존 꼬리 윤곽을 유지한다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared human skin region and positive discrete applied cosmetic pieces. Preserve all independently supplied owner, piece form, finish, material, size, arrangement, region and attachment restrictions. Do not select facets, thinness, adhesive type, removability, shape or location that the scene leaves unspecified. Never override bare skin, a pigment-only design, a natural marking or a garment/title carrier.
content.definition: Discrete cosmetic pieces form a positively declared decorative design directly on the selected human skin region. Each cosmetic piece has its own visible boundary and an attachment contact with that same skin surface. The actual declared piece form, finish, color, size, grouping and skin location remain unchanged. These surface-applied pieces remain separate from suspended jewelry, hair ornaments, garment trim, ordinary blush and a natural skin marking.
content.en: Discrete cosmetic pieces form a positively declared decorative design directly on the selected human skin region. Each cosmetic piece has its own visible boundary and an attachment contact with that same skin surface. The actual declared piece form, finish, color, size, grouping and skin location remain unchanged. These surface-applied pieces remain separate from suspended jewelry, hair ornaments, garment trim, ordinary blush and a natural skin marking.
content.ko: 개별 화장 장식 조각들이 선택된 사람의 피부 부위 위에 명시적으로 선언된 장식 디자인을 직접 이룬다. 각 조각에는 고유한 경계와 같은 피부 표면에 붙는 접촉이 보인다. 선언된 조각의 형태, 마감, 색, 크기, 모임과 피부 위치는 그대로 유지된다. 피부에 적용된 조각들은 매달린 보석 장신구, 머리 장식, 의복 테두리, 일반 볼터치나 자연 피부 표식과 구분된다.

content.application_contract: Require the independent scene to establish this existing iris and both named local structures. Preserve their same eye and actual physical-versus-depicted carrier domain, iris color, pupil shape, eye count, gaze and cosmetics. Do not extend anatomy to an undeclared owner/species, create features from a label, add pigmentation or peripheral furrows, diagnose disease or infer age/identity.
content.definition: Retain the already declared visible collarette and irregular crypts together on their same existing iris; a mere nearby collarette reference does not supply this combined visible relation.
content.en: The independently declared iris retains both its visible collarette and naturally irregular crypt texture in one existing eye. The collarette remains a distinct local boundary within that iris, and the crypts remain separate uneven surface hollows beside it. The established iris color, central pupil and surrounding eye white keep their own boundaries and existing appearance.
content.ko: 독립적으로 선언된 홍채가 기존 눈 하나 안에서 보이는 칼라레트와 자연스럽게 불규칙한 음와 질감을 함께 유지한다. 칼라레트는 그 홍채 내부의 구별되는 국소 경계로 남고 음와는 그 옆의 서로 떨어진 고르지 않은 표면 함몰로 유지된다. 기존 홍채 색, 중앙 동공과 주변 흰자위는 각각의 경계와 기존 외양을 유지한다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently declared human with existing visible hair and worn upper/lower garments whose grooming and clothing arrangement are open. Preserve the person’s actual declared age, identity, anatomy, count, garment ownership, existing reference appearance and every property lock. Do not add hair, a wearer, a garment outside the open scope, an adult/minor category, profession, personality, gender identity, venue, uniform or social role. Apply only the stated presentation effects to that same person; no pose, scene, exposure or camera change is granted. This authored visible arrangement supplies no native adoption permission.
content.definition: One existing human owns the visible deliberate hair arrangement and coordinated ordinary attire; informal presentation changes no declared age or identity.
content.en: The same existing person has their present hair arranged loosely but deliberately, leaving natural strand groups visible beside an ordinary top and everyday lower garment. The neckline, cuffs and garment junctions sit coherently on that wearer without rigid tailoring or dense decoration. The coordinated grooming and ordinary clothing create an informal overall presentation while the person’s already declared age, identity and body remain unchanged.
content.ko: 같은 기존 인물의 현재 머리카락을 느슨하되 의도적으로 정리하여 자연스러운 머리카락 묶음이 일상적인 상의와 하의 곁에 보이게 한다. 목둘레와 소매 끝, 옷이 만나는 경계는 딱딱한 재단이나 밀집 장식 없이 같은 착용자 위에서 일관되게 놓인다. 조율된 손질과 평범한 옷차림이 비격식적인 전체 외양을 이루고 이미 선언된 나이와 정체성, 몸은 그대로 유지한다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to the independently declared biological owner and already declared parts named here, whose requested shapes fit. Preserve exact species, count, color, established pose and scene. Quoted text, costume ornaments, figurative labels and neighboring bodies do not declare this owner. Develop only these same-owner structure properties; do not introduce an animal, transfer parts, infer transformation, health, mood or legal ownership. This research proposal remains discovery-only pending native semantic and owner admission review; all conditions, actual effects and requester locks require independent checking. Requires independently declared petiolate leaf and its existing same-plant stem, with attachment already intended. Preserve declared species, leaf count, blade shape, surface, color and pose. Do not create petioles on sessile leaves, substitute a leaflet petiolule, attach a cut specimen, introduce blossoms or borrow a neighboring stem. Physical botanical ownership does not authorize a diagram or artifact owner.
content.definition: The already declared petiolate leaf has a blade continuing into its own petiole. That petiole remains attached at its base to the same plant's existing stem. The blade-to-petiole boundary and petiole-to-stem junction form one continuous botanical route, with each part retaining its declared plant owner and existing shape.
content.en: The already declared petiolate leaf has a blade continuing into its own petiole. That petiole remains attached at its base to the same plant's existing stem. The blade-to-petiole boundary and petiole-to-stem junction form one continuous botanical route, with each part retaining its declared plant owner and existing shape.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 잎자루가 있는 잎의 잎몸은 자기 잎자루로 이어진다. 그 잎자루의 밑동은 같은 식물의 기존 줄기에 붙어 있다. 잎몸과 잎자루의 경계 및 잎자루와 줄기의 접합부는 하나로 이어지는 식물학적 경로를 이루고 각 부위는 선언된 식물의 소유 관계와 기존 모양을 유지한다.

content.application_contract: Apply only when the requester positively specifies a scene-affect reading, a visible pause or unresolved event phase, and an existing setting. A mere mood label, a word printed on an object, a physical atmosphere, an actor’s facial performance, or a known settled result does not satisfy those prerequisites. Preserve the declared moment and all event uncertainty. Do not invent a person, motive, gesture, departure, diagnosis, successful repair, light, gap, furnishing, retrospective memory or mental-state fact. Human owners are required only when independently declared. No native eligibility or execution is implied.
content.definition: A requested scene-affect reading is carried by an independently declared temporal moment in its already established surroundings: either an actual pause or an unresolved phase. The declaration supplies the event, setting and affect; this relation supplies no hidden participant or mandatory physical recipe.
content.en: An independently declared pause or unresolved event phase remains readable in relation to its existing surroundings. Sustain the requested emotional atmosphere through that already established moment and setting, while preserving the visible participants, actions and known event state. The proposed affect belongs to the photographic reading. It does not establish anyone’s private feelings, the reason for a pause, the identity of an absent person, a future outcome, or a new spatial interval or lighting arrangement.
content.ko: 독립적으로 선언된 멈춤이나 결과가 아직 정해지지 않은 사건 단계가 기존 주변 환경과의 관계 속에서 읽힐 수 있게 남는다. 이미 설정된 순간과 장소를 통해 요청된 정서적 분위기를 유지하며, 보이는 참가자와 행동 및 알려진 사건 상태를 보존한다. 제안된 정서는 사진의 해석에 속한다. 누구의 사적 감정, 멈춘 이유, 부재한 사람의 정체, 미래의 결과 또는 새로운 공간 간격이나 조명 배치를 사실로 확정하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only when the role independently declares an actual glass vase containing an actual sunflower. Preserve the existing plant and vessel owners, their containment relation, count and requested appearance. A flower name, printed picture, vase-shaped sculpture or genre label does not declare either actual entity. No water, bouquet, additional flower, leaf, support surface, exact shape, flower color or location is inferred.
content.en: A glass vase containing a sunflower is the independently declared photographic subject. The flowerhead and its continuous stem belong to the same cut sunflower, while the stem passes into the vase through its opening. The containing glass vessel and contained plant remain distinct physical owners within the selected floral arrangement. Preserve the independently selected flower count, glass clarity, vessel form and surrounding setting.
content.ko: 해바라기를 담은 유리 꽃병이 독립적으로 선언된 사진의 피사체이다. 꽃머리와 그에 이어진 줄기는 같은 절화 해바라기에 속하고 줄기는 꽃병 입구를 통해 내부로 들어간다. 담는 유리 용기와 그 안의 식물은 선택된 꽃꽂이 안에서도 서로 다른 물리적 소유자로 남는다. 독립적으로 선택된 꽃 수, 유리의 투명도, 용기 형태와 주변 배경을 보존한다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to the independently declared biological owner and already declared parts named here, whose requested shapes fit. Preserve exact species, count, color, established pose and scene. Quoted text, costume ornaments, figurative labels and neighboring bodies do not declare this owner. Develop only these same-owner structure properties; do not introduce an animal, transfer parts, infer transformation, health, mood or legal ownership. This research proposal remains discovery-only pending native semantic and owner admission review; all conditions, actual effects and requester locks require independent checking. Require an independently declared biological crane and the requested long-bill/narrow-leg arrangement. Preserve its exact crane species. A construction crane, embroidered crane, origami bird, borrowed bill or costume does not qualify; no color, age, migration, flock, landing or flight is implied.
content.definition: The independently declared crane's long bill continues from its own head. Its narrow visible legs join the same bird's body, and each visible foot remains at the end of its own leg. Bill base, leg roots and leg-to-foot paths retain the ownership of that one crane, preserving the bird's existing outline and configuration.
content.en: The independently declared crane's long bill continues from its own head. Its narrow visible legs join the same bird's body, and each visible foot remains at the end of its own leg. Bill base, leg roots and leg-to-foot paths retain the ownership of that one crane, preserving the bird's existing outline and configuration.
content.ko: 독립적으로 선언된 두루미의 긴 부리는 자기 머리에서 이어진다. 보이는 가느다란 다리는 같은 새의 몸에 연결되고 보이는 각 발은 자기 다리의 끝에 남는다. 부리 밑동과 다리 뿌리와 다리에서 발로 이어지는 경로는 그 두루미 한 마리의 소유 관계를 유지하며 기존 윤곽과 자세를 보존한다.

content.application_contract: Requires one independently declared existing object with actual upper and front surfaces available to view, and an open capture-camera direction. Preserve all declared object dimensions, attachments, orientation, support, identity and participant count. Do not introduce a table, box identity, support, human, room, camera height/distance, frame roll or lens setting. A depicted camera, body pose, title, height label or generic overhead placement cannot supply the optical-axis and two-face relationship. This is advisory geometry, not proof of exact physical calibration or capture history.
content.definition: Nonvertical downward pitch belongs to the capture camera; the same existing object supplies the visible upper and front surfaces.
content.en: The capture camera views the selected existing object along a diagonal downward optical axis, between a horizontal sightline and a vertical plan view. The actual upper surface and near-facing front face are both visible, with their shared boundary remaining coherent. This nonvertical camera direction preserves the object’s geometry and orientation; it does not require a tabletop or create a supporting surface.
content.ko: 촬영 카메라는 수평 시선과 수직 평면도 사이의 비스듬한 하향 광축으로 선택한 기존 물체를 바라본다. 실제 윗면과 가까운 쪽 앞면이 함께 보이며 두 면이 공유하는 경계는 일관되게 이어진다. 이 비수직 카메라 방향은 물체의 기하와 방향을 보존하며 테이블을 요구하거나 받침면을 만들지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires one independently present flat portable prop, one named actor, an existing table or work surface, a declared anatomical side, a selected prop edge and a selected support edge. Preserve every supplied owner, surface, edge identity, current open or closed state and actor posture. Do not introduce a table, tool, occupation, reading action, grip or image-relative side. An unspecified side or axis cannot be selected by this source.
content.definition: One existing flat portable prop rests on the independently named table or work surface beside the independently named actor. It lies on that actor's independently specified anatomical side. The independently designated edge of the same prop remains parallel to the selected edge of that supporting surface. The actor, prop and physical support provide the reference frame; image left or right does not replace the actor's side. Its actual supporting face, existing open or closed state and independently declared orientation remain intact. Flat describes the portable object class and does not require an otherwise undeclared broad-face-down orientation.
content.en: One existing flat portable prop rests on the independently named table or work surface beside the independently named actor. It lies on that actor's independently specified anatomical side. The independently designated edge of the same prop remains parallel to the selected edge of that supporting surface. The actor, prop and physical support provide the reference frame; image left or right does not replace the actor's side. Its actual supporting face, existing open or closed state and independently declared orientation remain intact. Flat describes the portable object class and does not require an otherwise undeclared broad-face-down orientation.
content.ko: 기존의 납작한 휴대 소품 하나가 독립적으로 지정한 인물 옆의 탁자나 작업 표면에 놓인다. 소품은 그 인물의 독립적으로 지정된 해부학적 측면에 있다. 같은 소품의 지정된 가장자리는 지지 표면의 선택된 가장자리와 평행하게 유지된다. 인물, 소품과 실제 지지면이 기준 좌표를 제공하며 화면의 왼쪽이나 오른쪽은 인물의 측면을 대신하지 않는다. 실제 지지 면, 기존의 열림이나 닫힘 상태와 독립적으로 선언한 방향은 유지된다. 납작함은 물체의 형태이며 선언하지 않은 넓은 면이 아래를 향한 상태를 강제하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires two existing objects, positively declared unequal image weight or a primary/secondary visual balance, and a declared open image region. Preserve every declared position and the actual field relationship; an intervening gap is required only when independently specified. No physical mass, size change, deleted object, new support, symmetry, diagonal path, silhouette treatment, or additional counterweight may be inferred. All guards and effects remain cumulative; this is advisory prose with no native-binding claim.
content.definition: The image preserves a declared unequal-prominence relation between exactly two existing objects together with the declared open-field placement relation. Coordinates and gap location remain requester parameters, rather than a fixed lower-left, symmetry or counterbalance recipe.
content.en: Two independently declared existing objects retain their requested unequal visual weight within one photograph. Both remain recognizable, while the named open image region stays contiguous and clear of their boundaries. Preserve the independently specified placement of that region, including an intervening gap when one is declared, and every specified object position. Relative visual weight belongs to the image presentation; it neither changes physical mass nor creates an additional counterweight, support, object or event.
content.ko: 독립적으로 선언된 기존 물체 둘이 한 사진 안에서 요청된 불균등한 시각적 무게를 유지한다. 둘 다 알아볼 수 있게 남고, 지정된 화면의 빈 영역은 두 물체의 경계와 분리되어 끊기지 않고 분명하게 유지된다. 두 물체 사이의 간격이 선언되었다면 그 간격을 포함하여 독립적으로 지정된 빈 영역의 위치와 각 물체의 위치를 보존한다. 상대적인 시각적 무게는 화면의 표현에 속하며 물리적 질량을 바꾸거나 추가 균형추, 받침, 물체 또는 사건을 만들지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently named primary visible owner and at least two existing visible supporting owners, with positive primary dominance and support readability. Do not convert the supporting group into a total second/third order. A total requested sequence needs a source that preserves that complete sequence. Equal-weight requests, actor gaze, quoted commands and nonvisual rank do not activate this relation. Do not add a physical arrangement, strongest-edge recipe, third attention level, lighting, actor gesture or material duty. Preserve all independent scene constraints. Review-required advisory meaning; no native-binding proof.
content.definition: The whole photograph preserves a declared partial prominence order: one primary existing owner precedes each of multiple existing supporting owners, with no required ordering between supports. All nominated owners remain recognizable.
content.en: Within one photograph, an independently declared primary visible owner leads attention while two or more already identified supporting owners remain subordinate and readable. Preserve the declared primary-to-support relations without assigning an order among the supporting owners. Every existing owner keeps its identity, action, connections and physical placement. This partial attention hierarchy belongs to photographic presentation and adds no participant, background layer, lighting method, camera treatment or event.
content.ko: 한 사진 안에서 독립적으로 지정된 주된 시각 대상이 주의를 이끌고, 이미 식별된 둘 이상의 보조 대상은 그보다 덜 두드러지면서 읽을 수 있게 남는다. 보조 대상들 사이의 순서를 지정하지 않고 선언된 주 대상과 보조 대상의 관계만 보존한다. 기존 대상들은 각자의 정체, 행동, 연결 및 물리적 위치를 유지한다. 이 부분적 주의 위계는 사진의 표현에 속하며 참가자, 배경 층, 조명 방식, 카메라 처리 또는 사건을 추가하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to the independently declared biological owner and already declared parts named here, whose requested shapes fit. Preserve exact species, count, color, established pose and scene. Quoted text, costume ornaments, figurative labels and neighboring bodies do not declare this owner. Develop only these same-owner structure properties; do not introduce an animal, transfer parts, infer transformation, health, mood or legal ownership. This research proposal remains discovery-only pending native semantic and owner admission review; all conditions, actual effects and requester locks require independent checking. Requires independently declared horse with existing hooves and mane. Do not add a breed, mane length or orientation, additional legs, hybrid forequarters, rider, equipment, action or location.
content.definition: The declared horse's existing hooves terminate its own lower limbs, with each visible hoof joined to the same limb above it. Mane hairs are rooted along that horse's own neck. Hoof-to-limb boundaries and mane roots remain anatomical parts of this one horse, retaining its established mane arrangement and stance.
content.en: The declared horse's existing hooves terminate its own lower limbs, with each visible hoof joined to the same limb above it. Mane hairs are rooted along that horse's own neck. Hoof-to-limb boundaries and mane roots remain anatomical parts of this one horse, retaining its established mane arrangement and stance.
content.ko: 선언된 말의 기존 발굽은 자기 다리 아래쪽의 끝을 이루며 보이는 각 발굽은 바로 위의 같은 다리에 연결된다. 갈기 털은 그 말 자신의 목을 따라 뿌리를 둔다. 발굽과 다리의 경계 및 갈기 뿌리는 이 말 한 마리의 해부학적 부위로 유지되며 기존 갈기 모양과 자세를 보존한다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently supplied same-person declaration with its exact actual place predicate, attribution, uncertainty and owner resolved. A missing or unknown biography, another person’s statement, or a camera location alone cannot activate it. Preserve only this predicate; do not invent age or convert it into another biographical relation, image lettering or physical appearance. No source verification, publication rights or model permission follows. All independently applicable age conditions, owner restrictions, native guards, permissions and identity effects remain binding; this template neither supplies nor waives them.
content.en: A portrait subject's explicitly supplied upbringing location describes where that same person spent their childhood. Preserve the exact stated childhood-place relation, its source attribution and uncertainty as contextual biography. It remains separate from the current photographic location and visible background, neither of which verifies it. This supplied history does not specify the person's current age, birthplace, residence, citizenship, ancestry or regional appearance.
content.ko: 인물사진 대상에게 명시적으로 제공된 성장 지역은 그 동일한 사람이 어린 시절을 보낸 곳을 뜻한다. 명시된 어린 시절 장소 관계, 그 출처 귀속과 불확실성을 전기적 맥락으로 정확히 보존한다. 이는 현재 촬영 위치 및 보이는 배경과 별개로 남으며 어느 쪽도 그 진술을 검증하지 않는다. 이 제공된 이력은 그 사람의 현재 나이, 출생지, 거주지, 시민권, 혈통이나 지역적 외양을 지정하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Apply only when an independent declaration establishes an existing particular wooden crate, one complete nonempty physical inscription and its attachment and local placement on that same actual crate. Preserve every exact character, space, punctuation mark, case, line arrangement and numeric leading zero, with every supplied glyph medium, color, carrier finish, position, ownership and illumination. The existing painted finish, if declared, belongs to the crate and does not establish that the inscription itself uses paint. An undeclared glyph medium stays undeclared; never choose paint, print, engraving or another production method to fill it. Do not introduce a carrier, inscription or character, move text from a caption or another owner, replace a specified medium, infer quantity or history from digits, or treat surrounding material/finish as proof of glyph manufacture. Missing inscription, carrier or physical relation requires review.
content.definition:
The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, case, spacing and line arrangement on the same existing wooden crate. Its visible glyphs stay attached to the specified crate face and local position, following the carrier’s perspective and board boundaries. Every independently specified glyph medium, color and illumination remains unchanged. The crate’s existing surface finish stays a separate carrier property; no inscription technology is selected from that finish.
이미 선언된 문구는 동일한 기존 나무 상자 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 간격과 줄 배열을 유지한다. 보이는 글자는 지정된 상자 면과 국소 위치에 붙어 있고 지지체의 원근과 판재 경계를 따른다. 독립적으로 지정된 글자의 매체와 색 및 조명은 모두 바뀌지 않는다. 상자의 기존 표면 마감은 지지체에 속하는 별개 속성으로 남으며, 그 마감에서 글자의 제작 기술을 선택하지 않는다.
content.en: The already declared inscription retains its complete character sequence, case, spacing and line arrangement on the same existing wooden crate. Its visible glyphs stay attached to the specified crate face and local position, following the carrier’s perspective and board boundaries. Every independently specified glyph medium, color and illumination remains unchanged. The crate’s existing surface finish stays a separate carrier property; no inscription technology is selected from that finish.
content.ko: 이미 선언된 문구는 동일한 기존 나무 상자 위에서 완전한 문자 순서, 대소문자, 간격과 줄 배열을 유지한다. 보이는 글자는 지정된 상자 면과 국소 위치에 붙어 있고 지지체의 원근과 판재 경계를 따른다. 독립적으로 지정된 글자의 매체와 색 및 조명은 모두 바뀌지 않는다. 상자의 기존 표면 마감은 지지체에 속하는 별개 속성으로 남으며, 그 마감에서 글자의 제작 기술을 선택하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently supplied same-person declaration with its exact actual place predicate, attribution, uncertainty and owner resolved. A missing or unknown biography, another person’s statement, or a camera location alone cannot activate it. Preserve only this predicate; do not invent age or convert it into another biographical relation, image lettering or physical appearance. No source verification, publication rights or model permission follows. All independently applicable age conditions, owner restrictions, native guards, permissions and identity effects remain binding; this template neither supplies nor waives them.
content.en: A portrait subject's explicitly supplied birthplace remains a birthplace statement belonging to that same person. Retain the supplied place, attribution and uncertainty with exactly that biographical predicate, without promoting the statement to verified history. The birth location remains distinct from the current capture location and visible setting. This declaration supplies no current age, upbringing, residence, citizenship, ancestry or facial characteristic.
content.ko: 인물사진 대상에게 명시적으로 제공된 출생지는 그 동일한 사람에게 속한 출생지 진술로 남는다. 그 진술을 검증된 이력으로 격상하지 않고 제공된 장소, 출처 귀속과 불확실성을 정확히 그 전기적 술어로 유지한다. 출생 장소는 현재 촬영 위치 및 보이는 배경과 구별한다. 이 선언은 현재 나이, 성장 지역, 거주지, 시민권, 혈통이나 얼굴 특징을 제공하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires one independently present serving utensil, vessel and its matching support dish with positive diagonal utensil placement. Preserve the actual utensil, vessel, dish, ownership and state. Do not invent a vessel, dish, support, hand, drink, material, exact angle or etiquette claim. Image-wide diagonal composition, a spoon inside the vessel or an unrelated plate cannot substitute.
content.definition: One existing slender serving utensil rests diagonally across the exposed area of the independently declared vessel's own matching support dish. The utensil contacts that actual dish while the same vessel retains its relationship to the same dish. The utensil's long axis is oblique within the physical cup-and-dish arrangement, rather than merely diagonal to the image border. The existing utensil, vessel and dish keep their separate identities and current states, without a hand supplying the support.
content.en: One existing slender serving utensil rests diagonally across the exposed area of the independently declared vessel's own matching support dish. The utensil contacts that actual dish while the same vessel retains its relationship to the same dish. The utensil's long axis is oblique within the physical cup-and-dish arrangement, rather than merely diagonal to the image border. The existing utensil, vessel and dish keep their separate identities and current states, without a hand supplying the support.
content.ko: 기존의 가느다란 식사용 도구 하나가 독립적으로 선언한 용기의 짝이 되는 받침 접시의 드러난 영역을 비스듬히 가로질러 놓인다. 도구는 그 실제 접시에 닿고 같은 용기는 같은 접시와의 관계를 유지한다. 도구의 긴 축은 단지 화면 테두리에 대해 대각선인 것이 아니라 실제 컵과 받침 접시의 배치 안에서 비스듬하다. 기존 도구, 용기와 접시는 각자의 정체성과 현재 상태를 유지하며 손이 지지를 대신하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Use only when the independent scene already identifies a water sample and explicitly declares its frozen state. Preserve that same sample and declared solid phase; do not infer frozen state from hue, droplets or a motion-freezing camera treatment. Do not invent a 0 °C value, pressure, purity, cooling process, duration, surface frost, cracking, container or transition history.
content.definition: An already declared water sample is retained as frozen solid ice without inferring a numeric temperature or completed freezing history.
content.en: The existing water sample retains the frozen physical state already declared by the independent scene. It is presented as that same sample in a solid ice state at the pictured moment, while its hue and illumination remain separate appearance choices. The declaration supplies no numerical temperature, specific ice shape, freezing event or prior state.
content.ko: 기존 물 시료가 독립적인 장면에서 이미 선언된 물리적으로 얼어 있는 상태를 유지한다. 사진 속 순간에 같은 시료가 고체 얼음 상태로 표현되며 색조와 조명은 별도의 외양 선택으로 남는다. 이 선언은 수치 온도, 특정 얼음 형태, 어는 사건이나 이전 상태를 제공하지 않는다.

content.application_contract: Requires the independent scene to identify an existing solid object and explicitly declare it physically warm. Preserve same carrier and material. Do not infer warm state from color, glow, a nearby heater or emotional wording. Add no numeric temperature, heat source, rate, duration, chemical identity, injury, melting or phase transition.
content.definition: Preserve an independently declared warm physical state on one existing solid carrier; warm-colored light is a different predicate.
content.en: The already identified solid object retains its independently declared warm physical temperature state at the pictured moment. Warmth belongs to that same object body, while its existing material and solid phase remain intact. Nearby objects, support surfaces and illumination retain their separately declared conditions without inheriting this temperature assignment.
content.ko: 이미 식별된 고체 물체가 사진 속 순간에 독립적으로 선언된 물리적으로 따뜻한 온도 상태를 유지한다. 따뜻함은 같은 물체 몸체에 속하고 기존 재료와 고체상은 그대로 남는다. 주변 물체, 받침 표면과 조명은 이 온도 지정을 물려받지 않고 각각 별도로 선언된 상태를 유지한다.

content.application_contract: Apply only to an independently declared actual tortoise animal. Preserve entity count, selected species and appearance, pose, and all required context. A word, embroidered motif, carving, sculpture or depicted animal inside another artifact does not establish the living subject. No snake, human handler, companion relation, habitat, domed shell, precise age or scale is inferred.
content.en: A tortoise is the independently declared animal subject, with its attached shell, head and limbs belonging to that same reptile. Its feet and visible limbs remain joined to its own body; neighboring ground, plants and other scene entities keep separate identities. Species, shell profile, color, size, age and pose remain those independently chosen for the actual animal.
content.ko: 육지거북은 독립적으로 선언된 동물 피사체이며 붙어 있는 등껍질과 머리, 팔다리가 같은 파충류에 속한다. 발과 보이는 다리는 그 자신의 몸에 연결되고 주변 땅, 식물과 다른 장면 개체는 별개의 정체성을 유지한다. 종, 껍질 윤곽, 색, 크기, 나이와 자세는 실제 동물에 대해 독립적으로 선택된 상태로 남는다.

content.application_contract: Requires an independently supplied same-person declaration with its exact actual place predicate, attribution, uncertainty and owner resolved. A missing or unknown biography, another person’s statement, or a camera location alone cannot activate it. Preserve only this predicate; do not invent age or convert it into another biographical relation, image lettering or physical appearance. No source verification, publication rights or model permission follows. All independently applicable age conditions, owner restrictions, native guards, permissions and identity effects remain binding; this template neither supplies nor waives them.
content.en: A portrait subject's supplied biography explicitly associates that same person with a stated personal place of origin. Preserve the exact source attribution, place meaning and uncertainty without claiming independent verification. The person's biographical origin, the camera's location and any place visible in the photograph remain distinct relations. This contextual statement does not supply an age, birthplace, citizenship, ancestry, clothing or facial trait.
content.ko: 인물사진 대상의 제공된 약력이 그 동일한 사람과 명시된 개인적 출신지를 연결한다. 독립적 검증을 주장하지 않고 정확한 출처 귀속, 장소의 의미와 불확실성을 보존한다. 그 사람의 전기적 출신지, 카메라 위치, 사진에 보이는 장소는 서로 다른 관계로 남는다. 이 맥락 진술은 나이, 출생지, 시민권, 혈통, 의상이나 얼굴 특징을 제공하지 않는다.
